content:
Education Domain - Student Services Regulations

Student services are governed by FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act), state education departments, and institutional policies.

For Student Admission: Required attributes include student name, date of birth, proof of age, previous academic records (transcripts), identity proof, parent/guardian name and contact (for minors), address, and admission test scores if applicable. Emergency contact information required. Medical information only if relevant to accommodation needs.

For Exam Registration: Required attributes include student identifier (student ID or enrollment number), exam name/code, registration date, exam center preference, and fee payment. Photo for admit card. Special accommodation requests require medical documentation if disability-related.

For Scholarship Application: Required attributes include student identifier, academic performance records, income documentation (for need-based scholarships), family information for means testing, bank account for disbursement, and supporting documents per scholarship criteria. Merit-based scholarships may not require income information.

For Library Membership: Required attributes include student identifier, name, contact information, and institutional affiliation verification. Photo for library card. Address required for overdue notice delivery. Library membership is typically automatic for enrolled students.

For Hostel Accommodation: Required attributes include student identifier, name, gender (for gender-segregated hostels), emergency contact information, medical information relevant to accommodation (allergies, medical conditions), and accommodation fee payment. Dietary restrictions if meal plans are included.

UNNECESSARY Attributes: Religion is unnecessary unless for religious institution accommodations. Caste is unnecessary unless specifically required by government reservation policies with legal basis. Political affiliation is never required. Social media profiles are unnecessary.

FERPA (20 USC 1232g) protects student education records. Parental consent required for disclosure of directory information. Student consent required after age 18.

GDPR Article 9(2)(g) allows processing special category data (including education records) when necessary for educational purposes.
